category: 微分方程 / 常微分方程
literal_source_claim_en: The original form of KAM theory.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only a KAM-family gloss. It fixes no phase space or torus dimension, Hamiltonian form, analytic or differentiable category, nondegeneracy hypothesis, frequency arithmetic condition, perturbation norm or threshold, invariant-embedding or conjugacy convention, frequency behavior, measure conclusion, source edition, or proof boundary. The 1954 Kolmogorov announcement and Arnold's later proof/formulations must not be silently merged, and the similarly named representation theorem is unrelated. Choosing a proposition at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix the scalar field, finite torus and action dimensions, phase space and domains, Hamiltonian function spaces and norms, symplectic convention, parameter carriers, and every analytic or differentiable structure.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose persistence of one specified-frequency torus, a nearby frequency-shifted torus, a canonical-conjugacy normal form, or a positive-measure family of surviving tori, nor the associated estimates, regularity, locality, or uniqueness.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case in scope-map.md.
